newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 10.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Thursday's Daily Variety:
NEW YORK - Time Warner Inc's about-to-be vice chairman and biggest shareholder, Ted Turner of Turner Broadcasting System Inc, wants to cut the company's $17 billion debt in half within three years.

HOLLYWOOD - ABC and its cable network sister the Disney Channel have inked development and production commitments for one series each from Lynch Entertainment, the creator of Viacom Inc Nickelodeon's hit kid show, "The Secret World of Alex Mack."
HOLLYWOOD - Although U.S. sales of recorded music have been mostly stagnant, overseas sales of compact disc's experienced a nearly 12 percent growth rate for the first six months of 1996.
